name: com.certifiedmailsender/certified-mail
title: Certified Mail Sender
description: USPS Certified Mail: person-approved or trusted auto-send, with optional electronic Return Receipt.

tools.name: quote_letter
tools.description: Get an itemized price for 1-10 pages or count a base64 PDF. Quoting is free. Unknown input fields are rejected with invalid_request; error.fix names each unknown field and the accepted fields. For a return receipt, use service certified_err. One page costs $9.04 for certified or $12.24 with an electronic Return Receipt; use quote_letter for the exact page count. Quoting never creates, pays for or mails a letter. No refund once USPS accepts the letter, even if USPS can't deliver it. If the person mentioned a deadline, compare it with the delivery estimate and tell them plainly when the estimate falls after it. Example: {"pages":1,"service":"certified"}

pages.description: Page count from 1 to 10. Provide exactly one of pages or pdf_base64; omit pages when providing a PDF.

pdf_base64.description: A base64-encoded PDF whose pages we count for the quote. Provide exactly one of pages or pdf_base64; omit pages when providing a PDF. Neither field takes precedence: sending both is rejected, even if the counts agree.

tools.name: create_letter
tools.description: Create a US domestic letter draft from exactly one of text, pdf_base64 or pdf_url. Creating a draft is free. Drafts cannot be edited. To change the text, an address or the service: create_letter with a new idempotency_key, give the person the new approval_url, then cancel_letter the old draft so the person cannot pay for the outdated draft. Tell the person the price from quote_letter before making the draft, unless they have already seen it. Unknown fields in the input, to or from are rejected with invalid_request; error.fix names each unknown field. Use organization for a company name, not company. For a return receipt, use service certified_err. An undeliverable address returns error.address_reason with a stable code, affected fields and USPS lookup URL; ask the person about that specific part. One page costs $9.04 for certified or $12.24 with an electronic Return Receipt; use quote_letter for the exact page count. Show approval_url to the person who will review and pay. For text, send the body from the greeting on; we add both addresses and the date. A different leading address block or date is refused with text_has_letterhead (422); remove the line named in the error. People who prefer to write or upload it themselves can use https://certifiedmailsender.com/send. Paid letters wait 30 minutes; send_now:true skips that hold only when the person asks. Screening still applies. Normally the person approves and pays; an auto-send key pays from its account balance. No refund once USPS accepts the letter, even if USPS can't deliver it. If the person mentioned a deadline, compare it with the delivery estimate and tell them plainly when the estimate falls after it. Test mode never mails. Example: {"to":{"name":"Jordan Lee","line1":"500 Market St","line2":"Suite 200","city":"Philadelphia","state":"PA","zip":"19106"},"from":{"name":"Sam Ortiz","line1":"12 Oak Ave","city":"Columbus","state":"OH","zip":"43215"},"service":"certified_err","text":"Dear Jordan,\n\n...","idempotency_key":"<a new UUID>"}

name.description: Person's full name. Omit or leave empty when sending to an organization only; either name or organization must contain nonblank text.

organization.description: Organization or company name. For an organization-only address, provide this and omit name. When both names are the same, we print the organization once.

to.description: Recipient address, checked by our printing partner against USPS records. If undeliverable during creation, the request is refused with address_undeliverable (422) and no draft is created. Read error.address_reason for its stable code, affected fields, plain explanation and USPS lookup URL; ask the person the specific question rather than guessing variants.

name.description: Person's full name. Omit or leave empty when sending to an organization only; either name or organization must contain nonblank text.

organization.description: Organization or company name. For an organization-only address, provide this and omit name. When both names are the same, we print the organization once.

service.description: certified sends USPS Certified Mail with USPS tracking. certified_err adds the electronic Return Receipt: a USPS PDF with the recipient's signature, once USPS provides it. Choose certified_err when the person wants proof of receipt.

text.description: The letter body, from the greeting on. We add the sender's address, the date and the recipient's address. Complete matching leading blocks are removed; a different leading address block or date is refused with text_has_letterhead (422), naming the line to remove. Subject lines and addresses after the greeting or first prose are allowed. Provide exactly one of text, pdf_base64 or pdf_url.

send_now.description: Choose true only when the person asks to skip the 30-minute cancellation hold after payment. Payment and any required approval are still required (auto-send pays from balance without per-letter approval), and every screening check must pass before submission. The letter can be canceled only until it is sent to the printing partner; skipping leaves no guaranteed cancellation period.

idempotency_key.description: Use a new UUID for a new letter; reuse it with the same body on retries. Anonymous keys need at least 16 characters.

tools.name: get_letter
tools.description: Read a letter's state, timeline, tracking, proof_of_mailing, acceptance_expected_by, cancel_until, send_now, refund and next step. proof_of_mailing gives the USPS acceptance record; cite its local date as the mailing date. acceptance_expected_by gives the Eastern deadline while waiting, and is null after an individual-piece scan even if acceptance is missing. Relay next_step for the plain explanation. refund gives state, amount_cents and destination (card or balance). accepted means the processor accepted it or the balance was credited, not that the bank has posted it; manual means we will refund it by hand. Address checks usually finish in seconds. A pending address_status is retried each minute for up to a day; read again after a minute. A busy queue or partner delay can slow the check. Reading is free and changes nothing. first_usps_scan identifies the earliest individual-letter scan, not shipment receipt; only proof_of_mailing establishes acceptance. partner_checked_at is the last successful tracking poll, not the scan date. files_deleted_at means downloads are gone. Repeated adjacent checks carry observations and last_at; at stays the first check. Timestamps are UTC RFC 3339 with milliseconds; date-only fields retain their documented calendar dates. If the person mentioned a deadline, compare it with the delivery estimate and tell them plainly when the estimate falls after it. Use id with its API key, or the complete private letter_url from create_letter. Example: {"letter_url":"https://certifiedmailsender.com/l/<id>?t=<token>"}

id.description: Letter id; send the API key that created it in Authorization.

letter_url.description: Complete private letter_url or approval_url, including its t token.

tools.name: list_letters
tools.description: List this API key's letters newest first, with cursor pagination. Listing is free and requires the creating API key; it changes nothing. first_usps_scan identifies the earliest individual-letter scan, not shipment receipt; only proof_of_mailing establishes acceptance. partner_checked_at is the last successful tracking poll, not the scan date. files_deleted_at means downloads are gone. Repeated adjacent checks carry observations and last_at; at stays the first check. Timestamps are UTC RFC 3339 with milliseconds; date-only fields retain their documented calendar dates. Pass next_cursor as cursor to read the next page. Example: {"limit":20}

tools.name: send_letter_now
tools.description: Skip a paid letter's 30-minute cancellation hold when the person asks to send it right away. This never bypasses screening and does not submit immediately. Idempotent while paid, screening or held for review; refused before payment or after submission or cancellation. Cancellation stays possible until submission, with no guaranteed extra time. Read the returned cancel_until and next_step; only the hold is skipped. Use id with its creating API key, or the complete private letter_url. Example: {"letter_url":"https://certifiedmailsender.com/l/<id>?t=<token>"}

id.description: Letter id; send the API key that created it in Authorization.

letter_url.description: Complete private letter_url or approval_url, including its t token.

tools.name: cancel_letter
tools.description: Cancel before submission to the printing partner and refund any payment in full. Read refund.state, refund.amount_cents and refund.destination in the result; do not claim a refund succeeded unless its state is accepted. Card refunds go back to the card paid with and usually show within 5 to 10 business days; the bank decides exactly when. Balance refunds return to the prepaid balance. Paid letters normally have a 30-minute hold. Canceling is free; a submitted letter cannot be canceled. Read the returned refund and next_step; cancellation does not mail anything. Use id with its API key, or the complete private letter_url. Example: {"letter_url":"https://certifiedmailsender.com/l/<id>?t=<token>"}

id.description: Letter id; send the API key that created it in Authorization.

letter_url.description: Complete private letter_url or approval_url, including its t token.
